title: Qualify CCP2 radios and full-band plans
description: Qualify exact selected board/radio/antenna/firmware configurations for CCP2 baseline and separately proposed wider conventional-LoRa plans. Candidate128 grid902.3+i*0.2MHz ends927.7MHz; it is not active or automatically approved. Measure low/mid/high-band tuning/performance, occupied spectrum/band-edge behavior, oscillator error/drift, actual retune/CAD/settling/IRQ timing and complete operation scheduling. Exercise RX commitments versus TX, driverfailure and recovery. Concentrator tests must model actual passbands/channelbanks/demodulator counts and TX concurrency, not128-channel simultaneousRX. Follow docs/bench-operations.md; no device ports, fieldRF, purchases or external approvals without explicit authorization. Keep unsupported variants/operatingbases disabled.
acceptance_criteria: Repeatable captures/timing/emissions evidence and device-specific authorization source correlate to exact profile and software revision. Show actual indexed plan lookup, masks and radio settings; do not infer from PLLrange or compilechecks. Report tested/notassessed configurations and any no-go findings; no genericcertification,capacity,TCXOaccuracyor100usretune claims.
